chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa narrated from Mu'awiya ibn Hakim from Ibrahim ibn 'Uqbah from al-Hasan al-Taflisī who said:

I asked al-Ridha (peace be upon him): Is one permitted to enjoy (marry temporarily) the Jewish and Christian women? He said: Enjoying the free believing woman is more beloved to me, and she is greater in sanctity than them.
ai.seo_question: Is temporary marriage permissible with People of the Book according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-istibsar, Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon him) clarifies the permissibility of temporary marriage (mut'ah) with Ahl al-Kitab, affirming its validity while elevating the status of a free believing woman (al-hurrah al-mu'minah) as more beloved and possessing greater sanctity (hurma). This distinction reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle that while the general ruling permits mut'ah with chaste women of the Book, the spiritual and social merit of a Muslim woman makes her the preferred choice, reinforcing the hierarchy of religious identity in marital relations.
